manifest.name: client-resume-button
manifest.description: Adds a Continue button to the DeepSeek Harness composer: when the previous turn was interrupted (by the user, a crash, or an error), one click asks the model to pick that turn back up.
manifest.author: ddy-007

bundle.text:
# client-resume-button bundle patch：插入宿主侧插件行。
# 「继续」按钮的浏览器半边由同一个 entry 的 dsh.client 声明自动发现。
- insert:
    - id: client-resume-button
      name: client-resume-button

readme.text:
[](./LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

给 DeepSeek Harness 的输入框加一个「继续」按钮：上一轮被中断后，点一下就能让模型接着把那一轮做完。

[English](./README.en.md) | 中文

---
红圈处即「继续」按钮，位于模型选择器左侧。开始输入或添加附件时它收窄消失，清空后展开回来。

按钮可见需要同时满足两点：

- 上一轮以 `aborted`（用户按停止）、`interrupted`（崩溃）或 `error` 结束
- 主提交按钮处于禁用态——即输入框为空、没有待上传附件、也没有轮次在跑

`aborted` 只在子原因为用户主动停止时才算，超时或策略取消不算。

点击后发送两条 plugin 来源的提示给模型：一条要求继续，一条提醒检查残留进程、不重做已完成步骤。

```
插件页 → 「添加插件」→ 输入 client-resume-button → 安装 → 重启 DSH
```

命令行等价写法（`--profile` 填你实际在用的：桌面客户端 `desktop`，`dsh web` 用 `web`）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add client-resume-button
```

**装完必须重启 DSH**，浏览器端代码只在启动时加载。

<details>
<summary>其他安装方式</summary>

从 Git 仓库（需要能访问 `github.com`）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:ddy-007/dsh-client-resume-button
```

若 `github.com` 不可达，可临时借助 `ghproxy.net` 这类第三方镜像转发。镜像只是绕开网络限制的便利手段，不是推荐路径——它会把安装流量经第三方转发，其供应链可信度未经本项目评估。优先用 npm 包或直连 GitHub。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://ghproxy.net/https://github.com/ddy-007/dsh-client-resume-button.git
```

改源码时用 `link:`，不必每次重装，改完只需重启：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:<仓库绝对路径>"
```

</details>

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove client-resume-button
```

```sh
npm test         # 契约测试：投影折叠、按钮可见性、内部约定自检
npm run record   # 每态一次折叠的人可读记录
npm run verify   # 在临时 DSH_HOME 里用真实投影注册表跑一遍
```

测试分三层：`lib/projection.js` 的折叠逻辑（不需要装依赖、不联网）、`shouldShowButton` 的显示判断、以及 `probeContracts` 的内部约定自检。后两者由 `tests/support/load-client.mjs` 在 Node 里装载 `lib/client.js` 后调用——宿主把 React 打包在 `app.asar` 内，本地没有可解析的 React，所以覆盖的是判断逻辑，不是渲染结果。

`npm run verify` 需要 SDK 依赖（`pnpm install`），它会挂载真实的 Cordis 上下文与投影注册表，向真实 `Session` 追加真实事件，再读客户端渲染用的那份快照。

用例的事件形状取自真实会话日志，不是构造的近似值。
CI（`.github/workflows/ci.yml`）跑四个作业：投影测试、隔离中断态、对真实 harness 的 `npm install`、打包内容核对。

- **按钮位于模型选择器左侧**，不在主提交按钮旁。更近的 `conversation.input.activity` 槽位是 `single` 类型，已被语音输入插件占用，抢占会导致应用无法启动。
- **开始新一轮后按钮就消失**。中断标记会在下一次 `turn/start` 时清除——中断后只要又发了消息，无论内容是什么，都无法再「继续上一轮」。
- **不能恢复中断时的半截输出**。那部分内容从未写入日志，插件是新开一轮 turn 重做，而非续写原流。

实测 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.2`。`dsh.engines.dsh` 声明 `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.2.1-0 || >=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`，低于下界或达到 `0.3.0`（含 `0.3.0-rc.1` 这类预发布版）会被拒绝安装。

范围写成两段而不是 `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`，是因为后者会静默排除所有 `0.2.1-*` 预发布版：node-semver 只有在**某个比较符自身**与目标版本共享完整的 `major.minor.patch` 元组、且该比较符带预发布标签时才放行预发布版本。写成一整段时，`0.2.1-rc.2` 被排除，`npm install` 会直接报 `ERESOLVE`。DSH 自己的兼容门用 `includePrerelease: true` 求值，恰好看不出这个问题——所以两段式是这个缺陷的修复，不是风格偏好。

同样地，`@deepseek-ai/*` 的 peer 范围全部写明版本线，没有一处用 `"*"`。这些包在 npm 上的 `latest` 标签停留在很久以前的版本（配套 harness 的线在 `next` 上），`"*"` 会让 npm 挑 `latest`，展开出一份 `0.0.x` 的旧依赖图，其中包含从未发布到 npm 的包，安装当场失败。

依赖以下内部约定，DSH 升级后可能失效：`turn/end` reason 枚举、`conversation.input.right` 槽位、`<hash>_primary` 类名、`agent.inbox.prepend` / `agent.steer`、`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`。

[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

Adds a **Continue** button to the DeepSeek Harness composer. When the previous turn was interrupted, one click asks the model to pick that turn back up.

[中文](./README.md) | English

---
The circled button is **Continue**, sitting left of the model selector. It collapses when you start typing or attach a file, and expands back when the composer is cleared.

The button is visible when both hold:

- The previous turn ended with `aborted` (user pressed stop), `interrupted` (crash), or `error`
- The primary submit button is disabled — meaning the composer is empty, no attachment is pending upload, and no turn is running

`aborted` only counts when the sub-reason is the user pressing stop; a timeout or policy cancel does not.
On click it sends two plugin-origin notices to the model: one asking it to continue, one reminding it to check for leftover processes and not repeat completed steps.

```
Plugins → Add plugin → enter client-resume-button → install → restart DSH
```

Command-line equivalent (`--profile` is the profile you actually run: `desktop` for the desktop client, `web` for `dsh web`):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add client-resume-button
```

**Restart DSH afterwards** — the browser half loads at startup only.

<details>
<summary>Other install methods</summary>

From the Git repository (requires reaching `github.com`):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:ddy-007/dsh-client-resume-button
```

If `github.com` is unreachable, a third-party mirror such as `ghproxy.net` can relay the clone. A mirror is a convenience for working around network restrictions, not a recommended path — it routes your install through a third party whose supply-chain trust this project has not assessed. Prefer the npm package or a direct GitHub connection.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://ghproxy.net/https://github.com/ddy-007/dsh-client-resume-button.git
```

While editing the source, use `link:` so you do not reinstall on every change:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:<absolute path to the repo>"
```

</details>

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove client-resume-button
```

```sh
npm test         # contract tests: projection fold, button visibility, internal-contract probe
npm run record   # one printed fold per state
npm run verify   # mounts the real projection registry in a throwaway DSH_HOME
```

The suite covers three layers: the fold in `lib/projection.js` (no installed dependencies, no network), the `shouldShowButton` visibility rule, and the `probeContracts` internal-contract check. The latter two load `lib/client.js` in Node through `tests/support/load-client.mjs` — the host bundles React inside `app.asar` and there is no resolvable React locally, so they cover the decision, not the rendering.

`npm run verify` needs the SDK (`pnpm install`): it mounts a real Cordis context and the real projection registry, appends real events to a real `Session`, then reads the snapshot the client renders from.

The event shapes in the suite come from real session logs rather than invented approximations.

CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs four jobs: projection tests, isolated interruption states, an `npm install` against the real harness, and a packed-contents check.

- **The button sits left of the model selector**, not next to the primary submit button. The closer `conversation.input.activity` slot is a `single` slot already taken by the voice-input plugin; claiming it prevents the app from starting.
- **Starting a new turn dismisses it.** The interruption mark is cleared on the next `turn/start` — once you send anything after interrupting, the chance to continue that turn is gone.
- **It cannot restore the interrupted output.** That partial content was never persisted. The plugin starts a new turn; it does not resume a token stream.

Verified on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. `dsh.engines.dsh` declares `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.2.1-0 || >=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`; below that floor, or at `0.3.0` (including `0.3.0-rc.1` and other prereleases of it), the install is refused.

The range is written in two segments rather than `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0` because the single-segment form silently excludes every `0.2.1-*` prerelease: node-semver only admits a prerelease version when *some comparator itself* shares its full `major.minor.patch` tuple and carries a prerelease tag. With one segment, `0.2.1-rc.2` is excluded and `npm install` fails with `ERESOLVE`. DSH's own compatibility gate evaluates with `includePrerelease: true`, which hides the problem — so the two-segment form is a fix, not a style preference.

For the same reason, every `@deepseek-ai/*` peer range names a version line and none uses `"*"`. These packages keep a long-stale `latest` tag (the harness-matched line sits on `next`), so a wildcard resolves to an old `0.0.x` graph that includes packages never published to npm, and the install fails outright.

Relies on these internal contracts, which may change across DSH releases: the `turn/end` reason enum, the `conversation.input.right` slot, the `<hash>_primary` class name, `agent.inbox.prepend` / `agent.steer`, and `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`.
